name: Loops Stutter in Live Mode
hint: A timed hardware action is the central operation repeated by a loop in live mode or in a path that may run live. Repeatedly transmitting that command can pause or stutter the robot.
instruction: Use upload mode for such actions when appropriate, or restructure the loop so the timed command is not resent on every iteration; apply the same care to possible live paths.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when Codey is shaking :: events hat
forever
@codeyA keep straight forward at power (50) % for (1) secs :: motion
end
